name: Mississippi Pot Roast
reason: Direct duplicate of catalog recipe 'Mississippi Pot Roast Bowls' (slug mississippi-pot-roast-bowls, items beef-chuck-roast/butter/pepperoncini/rice): identical dish - same protein (beef chuck), same slow-cooker method, same ranch + au-jus + pepperoncini braise flavor family; the catalog version simply plates it over rice as bowls but it is the same dinner (name-same, dish-same).

fit.note: Published 481 cal / 4 g carbs per serving clears the 400-650 cal and <=35 g carb band; no seafood; slow-cooker shred scales to 14 - fit is fine, but it loses on duplication, not on conditions.

cross_protein_collision: Catalog also carries slow-cooker-mississippi-pork-bowls (pork) and slow-cooker-ranch-pork-potato-bowls - the Mississippi/ranch-braise template already spans beef and pork, so the decider should watch for any Mississippi/ranch chicken or turkey twin in other selectors' pools.
